definitions.gloss: waist cord (used when putting on a kimono)
definitions.explanation: A thin cloth cord tied around the waist, used mainly to hold a kimono in place while dressing, before the {帯|おび} is added.

examples.japanese: ⟦{着物|きもの}→着物：01309_kimono⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{腰紐|こしひも}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{留|と}めた→留める：10053_tomeru⟧。
examples.english: I secured the kimono with a waist cord.

examples.japanese: {腰紐|こしひも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦きつく→きつい：02342_kitsui⟧⟦{結|むす}び→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧すぎた。
examples.english: I tied the waist cord too tightly.

examples.japanese: {着付|きつ}けで⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{何本|なんぼん}⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{腰紐|こしひも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}って→使う：00473_tsukau⟧⟦{形|かたち}→形：02193_katachi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{整|ととの}える→整える：04259_totonoeru⟧。
examples.english: When dressing in kimono, several waist cords are used to shape the garment.

notes:
A thin cloth cord tied at the waist, used mainly when putting on a kimono to hold the layers in place before the ⟦{帯|おび}→帯：02610_obi⟧ (sash) is added.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {腰紐|こしひも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{結|むす}ぶ→結ぶ：02308_musubu⟧: to tie a waist cord
- {着付|きつ}け⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{腰紐|こしひも}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use waist cords when dressing in kimono

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{帯|おび}→帯：02610_obi⟧: the wide decorative kimono sash worn over everything
- {伊達|だて}{締|じ}め: a wider supporting band used in kimono dressing
